identity.supersede_reason: v1 held reference answers, graders and solutions in plaintext on the worker-visible branch, so its held-out split is burned and cannot be reused for counted qualification
identity.sharding: one JSONL shard per required (product_family, size) cell
identity.canonical_order: product_family ascending, then size in S, M, L, XL order, then record index ascending within a shard
identity.byte_pin: every shard is pinned by sha256 in CORPUS_SHARD_DIGESTS.txt, whose own sha256 is pinned by the manifest, whose sha256 is pinned by SHA256SUMS

notes.why_sharded: one shard per required cell makes the split identity and the per-cell depth readable without a 240-entry membership list, and lets a cell be re-minted without touching the other fifteen
notes.why_no_calibration_split: this artifact freezes only the qualification held-out corpus. Screening and routing calibration continue to use the v1 pool, which the independence checker treats as a contaminating foreign corpus so that no held-out input can be reused from it.
